scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge and requesting a refund if the transaction is found to be unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Darnell Robinson and I'm 80. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Mr. Robinson, I'm sorry to hear about this concern regarding your account. I would be happy to help you investigate this charge. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of your social security number for verification?
Sure, my account number is 8829-4410-22 and the last four of my social are 9982.

Thank you for verifying those details, Mr. Robinson. I have pulled up your account. I see the transaction you are referring to—it is a $76.00 charge from 'Global Tech Services' dated two days ago. Does that name sound familiar to you at all?
No, I've never heard of Global Tech Services. I haven't bought anything online in months.

I understand. Per our security policy for unrecognized transactions, I have reviewed the merchant details. Since this appears to be a potential unauthorized use of your card, I have initiated a formal dispute for this charge. I have also placed a temporary block on your current card to prevent further unauthorized activity and have ordered a replacement card to be sent to your address on file.
Oh, that sounds serious. Does that mean I'll get my money back?

Yes, Mr. Robinson. Under our Fraud Protection Guarantee, we have issued a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours while the investigation is finalized. You will not be held liable for this unauthorized transaction.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized merchant, initiated a dispute, blocked the compromised card, and issued a provisional credit.

judge_scores.justification: The agent conducted appropriate security verification, maintained a warm and reassuring tone while addressing the customer's concerns, and efficiently resolved the issue by initiating a dispute, securing the account, and issuing a provisional credit under the Fraud Protection Guarantee. Concrete actions were taken immediately without any unnecessary delays or escalations.
